operation.description: Lists every membership the caller can read: an account API key its account's; a user credential their own plus those of every account they manage. `account_id` and `user_id` only narrow that list — values outside the caller's reach return fewer results, not an error.

parameters.description: Narrow to one account (`biz_` tag). With read access to the account this lists all of its memberships; without, only the caller's own memberships in it.
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.description: Narrow to one user's memberships (`user_` tag, or `me` for the caller). A user outside the caller's visible set returns an empty list.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Narrow to one member's memberships (`mber_` tag), including memberships bought by another business. A member outside the caller's visible set returns an empty list.
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.description: Narrow to memberships linked to one Discord or Telegram account, given as the platform's user ID prefixed with `discord_` or `telegram_`. Discord matches include memberships imported with that Discord ID. Any other format is a 400.
parameters.name: external_account

parameters.description: Filter by billing state. `trialing`, `active`, `past_due`, `completed`, `canceled`, and `expired` match the membership's `status`; `active`, `trialing`, and `past_due` exclude memberships set to cancel at period end. The other values are derived buckets that never appear as a `status`: `canceling` matches memberships set to cancel at period end; `paused` matches memberships with payment collection paused; `expiring` matches one-time purchases that have not yet expired; `one_time` matches one-time purchases that never expire; `unclaimed` matches memberships with no buyer user, including memberships bought by another business; `banned` matches memberships whose buyer is banned from the account.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter to memberships matching any of these billing states, with the same meanings as `status`. Repeat the parameter to pass several. Combined with `status` when both are sent.
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.description: Filter to memberships of this product (`prod_` tag).
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: Filter to memberships of any of these products, each prefixed `prod_`. Repeat the parameter to pass several.
parameters.name: product_ids

parameters.description: Filter to memberships of this variant (`plan_` tag).
parameters.name: variant_id

parameters.description: Filter to memberships of any of these variants, each prefixed `plan_`. Repeat the parameter to pass several.
parameters.name: variant_ids

parameters.description: Filter to memberships discounted by any of these promo codes, each prefixed `promo_`. Repeat the parameter to pass several.
parameters.name: promo_code_ids

parameters.description: Only memberships created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Only memberships created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Sort field.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Sort direction.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Number of results to return from the start of the range.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: Return results after this cursor. Use `page_info.end_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page.
parameters.name: after

parameters.description: Number of results to return from the end of the range.
parameters.name: last

parameters.description: Return results before this cursor. Use `page_info.start_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the previous page.
parameters.name: before

parameters.description: Set to `true` to return the number of matching results in `page_info.total_count`. Send `first=0` as well to return the count without any results.
parameters.name: include_total_count

total_count.description: Number of results matching the filters, across every page. Counting stops at 10,000. `null` when `include_total_count` isn't `true`, or when the count ran out of time.

total_count_capped.description: Whether counting stopped at the limit. `true` means `total_count` is 10,000 or more.

account.description: The account (seller) this membership belongs to.

affiliate.description: The membership's affiliate commission. `null` without an affiliate, without `affiliate:basic:read` on the account, and always in webhooks.

billing_period_days.description: Number of days between recurring charges. `null` for non-renewing memberships or memberships with multiple renewal schedules.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether the membership is set to cancel when the current billing period ends. Only meaningful for recurring variants.

cancel_option.description: The category the member picked for why they canceled. `null` when no category was picked.

canceled_at.description: When cancellation was requested, or when the membership was canceled if no request time is recorded, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when neither is recorded.

cancellation_reason.description: Free-text explanation provided when canceling. `null` when no reason was provided.

collection_method.description: How renewals are collected. `charge_automatically` charges the saved payment method each period; `send_invoice` emails the buyer an invoice each period. `null` when not set.

created_at.description: When the membership was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

current_period_end.description: When the current billing period renews, or when a non-renewing membership expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` for one-time purchases with no expiration.

current_period_start.description: When the current billing period started, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when no billing period is recorded.

expires_at.description: When access ends for a membership with a fixed expiration, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when the membership has no expiration, such as a renewing membership.

items.description: The member's accounts on outside platforms, such as Discord and Telegram. Empty when the member has none linked. `null` in webhooks.

feedback_option.description: The account's own cancel reason the member picked, as they saw it. `null` when the member picked a default category or gave no reason.

initial_price.description: The variant's current up-front price, in the variant's currency. A list price, not necessarily what the buyer paid. `amount` is `"0.00"` when the first charge is free.

license_key.description: The software license key for this membership. Only present when the product includes a software licensing experience.

manage_url.description: URL where the buyer can sign in to manage billing. `null` without a member record or unless the caller is the buyer or has `member:manage` on the account.

member.description: The caller's member row on the account. Present only when the membership belongs to the caller; `null` on seller-side reads.

member_id.description: The buyer's member record on the account, prefixed `mber_`. `null` when the membership has no member record, such as an unclaimed membership.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs stored on the membership, commonly used for software licensing.

most_recent_action.description: The membership's latest lifecycle event, such as `renewing_on` or `canceled_on`. Pair it with `most_recent_action_at`. `null` when none is recorded.

most_recent_action_at.description: When `most_recent_action` happened or is scheduled to happen, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. A future time for upcoming events such as `renewing_on`. `null` when no action is recorded.

phone_number.description: The buyer's phone number recorded for this membership, or `null`. The number collected (or verified) at checkout when the seller's phone collection is on; falls back to the buyer's account number when they have shared one with this seller.

product.description: The product this membership grants access to.

product_id.description: The product this membership grants access to, prefixed `prod_`.

promo_code_id.description: The promo code discounting this membership, prefixed `promo_`. `null` when none is applied. Set at checkout or by Apply Promo Code to Membership.

renewal_price.description: The variant's renewal price, in the variant's currency, after any promo code that still applies. A membership billed in the buyer's local currency is charged this price converted at the exchange rate on each billing date. `null` for non-renewing memberships.

split_pay_current_payments.description: Paid installments counted so far on a split pay membership. `null` when the membership is not on split pay, or before its first installment is counted.

split_pay_required_payments.description: Installment payments required before the membership stops billing. `null` when the membership is not on split pay.

status.description: Billing state of the membership. `active`/`trialing` memberships grant access; `past_due` is the grace period after a failed payment; `completed` one-time purchases keep access; `canceled`/`expired` do not.

updated_at.description: When the membership was last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Reflects the most recent change to the membership itself, so you can reconcile against webhook retries, replays, and backfills.

user_id.description: The buyer, prefixed `user_`. `null` when the buyer is another business or the membership is unclaimed.

variant_id.description: The variant the buyer purchased, prefixed `plan_`.

banner_image_url.description: Account banner image URL. `null` when the account has not set one.

logo_url.description: Account logo image URL. `null` when the account has not set one.

route.description: Account public route identifier, used in the `whop.com/{route}` storefront path.

applies_to_payments.description: Whether the commission is paid on the membership's first payment only or on all its payments.

commission_amount.description: The flat fee commission in the membership currency, or `null` for a percentage.

commission_percentage.description: The percentage commission in percentage points, so `20` means 20%, or `null` for a flat fee.

commission_source.description: How the commission rate was set: `custom` for a rate set for this affiliate, `member` for the member affiliate rate of the plan or product, `global` for the product's global affiliate rate, or `marketplace` for a Whop marketplace referral.

commission_type.description: Whether the commission is a percentage or a flat fee.

enabled.description: Whether this membership pays affiliate commissions. `false` means the affiliate is kept on the membership but is no longer paid.

user_id.description: ID of the affiliate's user, prefixed `user_`.

external_id.description: The member's user ID on the platform, such as a Discord user ID. Prefixed with the platform (`discord_<external_id>`), it is the `external_account` value List Memberships filters by.

platform.description: The platform the member's account is on.

username.description: The member's username on the platform. `null` when Whop doesn't know it, such as for a membership imported with only a Discord ID.

label.description: The option's label when the member picked it. Renaming the option later does not change it.
label.example: The wash club costs more than I can spend

amount.description: The amount in major units, as an exact decimal string. For example, `"10.00"` is ten dollars. It is a string so that no float rounds it in transit.

decimals.description: How many decimal places the amount carries. This is the precision the charge itself runs at.

display_decimals.description: How many decimal places to SHOW. Usually equal to `decimals`, and deliberately not always: COP is charged in centavos but written in whole pesos, so it is `2` and `0`. Format the number in your own locale using this.

access_level.description: What the member can reach on the account: `customer` for paying members, `admin` for team members, `no_access` once every grant has lapsed.

last_accessed_at.description: When the member last opened the account's content, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` if they never have.

position.description: The member's sort position in the buyer's own account list. `null` until they arrange it.

logo_url.description: Product logo image URL. `null` when the product has no logo.

code.description: Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
